messages:
maria.finance: Heads up — nightly billing produced ~120 invoices with a negative 'proration' line and many of them already synced to Stripe + NetSuite. Example: invoice inv_0072 has a -$12.50 prorated line. Not sure if this is a generation bug or a duplicate webhook replay. anyone able to look?
kevin.engineering: Ugh. Is there a sample webhook payload or consumer log we can inspect?
maria.finance: Pasting a redacted payload from inv_0072: 
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_7a9f",
  "invoice_id": "inv_0072",
  "lines": [{"amount": -1250, "currency": "usd", "desc": "prorated usage credit"}],
  "source": "billing-run-2026-03-22T23:00Z"
}
```
rahul.recon: Reconer shows the ledger entry then a separate credit memo with the same invoice id a few seconds later. The DLQ also has duplicates. Looks like our consumer created a reversal twice due to retries — idempotency key wasn't honored for this event type.
kevin.engineering: I see in the webhook-proxy logs two POSTs with the same payload.event_id but different signature headers (we rotated keys last night). The proxy computes the idempotency key from the signature header, so the rotation made the same event look different. That's the immediate bug.
billing-bot: alert: billing-run_v2 finished with 502 webhook retries and 127 DLQ entries.
sarah.ops: Immediate ask from ops/finance: can we pause the NetSuite posting queue for credits so duplicates don't land while we fix the idempotency? Need finance approval to hold postings.
emily-ops: +1 to pause for 30m to give eng a window to deploy a fix and inspect DLQ.
maria.finance: I approve a 30 minute pause. Also request team not to run any automated backfills until we confirm canonical state.
kevin.engineering: Mitigation plan: 1) hotfix proxy to compute idempotency key from payload.event_id (not signature). 2) add extra dedupe check in consumer. 3) deploy to staging, smoke test, then prod. ETA ~2 hours. After that we can reprocess DLQ with a safe dry-run and then apply.
rahul.recon: I'll assemble the list of affected invoices (~120) and prepare a backfill script that is conservative: detect duplicates and only create manual credit memos if NetSuite shows a missing reversal. If we need manual journals, I'll coordinate with @sara.accounting.
sara.accounting: I can create journals/credits but need a ticket with invoice ids + justification and a timestamp window. Prefer automated reversal if we can validate it.
kevin.engineering: Opening PR now and will post the link here once ready.
maria.finance: thanks all. tagging @cto for visibility. keep updates in this thread. :eyes:
